hibernate-mapping.query: select count(o) from TransportOrder o where o.loadUnit.barcode = :barcode
from RetrievalOrder o where o.shippingUser = :user and o.status = :status
from LoadUnit lu where lu.location.name = :name

select distinct u.id from LoadUnit u join u.stockItems s where u.type = :tote and u.location.name like :pick and s.reservation.retrievalOrderLine.order.automatic = true and not exists (select t.id from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = u and t.status in :open)

select distinct o from RetrievalOrder o join o.lines l join l.reservations r where o.status = :status and o.automatic = true and r.stockItem.loadUnit.location.area = :area and not exists (select t from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = r.stockItem.loadUnit and t.status in :open)
select count(t) from TransportOrder t where t.status = :active and t.target.name = :target and t.loadUnit.location.name = :point and t.loadUnit.barcode <> :barcode
from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = :loadUnit and t.status = :active
select count(t) from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = :tote and t.status in (:new, :active)
select count(t) from TransportOrder t where t.target = :location and t.status in :open
select count(t) from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = :tote and t.status in :open
from StorageLocation l where l.name like :pick and l.loadUnits is empty and l.id not in (select a.location.id from ArticlePickingLocation a)
from ArticlePickingLocation a where a.article = :article
from LoadUnit u where u.type = :type and u.location.name in :places

select s from StockItem s join s.loadUnit u join u.location l join s.articlePackagingUnitType p where p.article = :article and s.reservation is null and type(l) = StorageLocation order by case when l.name like :pick then 0 else 1 end, s.id
from ArticlePackagingUnitType p where p.article = :article and p.packagingUnitType.quantity = 1 order by p.id
from RetrievalOrder o where o.status <> :finished order by o.id
select s from StockItem s join s.loadUnit u join u.location l where s.reservation is null and type(l) = StorageLocation
select o.orderId from RetrievalOrder o where o.status = :status order by o.id
select count(o) from RetrievalOrder o where o.orderId = :id
select count(o) from ReceivingOrder o where o.orderId = :id
from StorageLocation l where l.aisle > 0 and l.loadUnits is empty and l.id not in (select t.target.id from TransportOrder t where t.status in :open) order by l.x asc

select u.id from LoadUnit u where u.type = :pallet and u.location.name = :decanting and not exists (select s.id from StockItem s where s.loadUnit = u and s.reservation is not null) and not exists (select t.id from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = u and t.status in :open)

select distinct u.id from StorageLocation l join l.loadUnits u join u.stockItems s where l.aisle > 0 and s.reservation is not null and not exists (select t.id from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = u and t.status in :open)
select count(s) from StockItem s where s.loadUnit.barcode = :barcode and s.reservation is not null
select count(s) from StockItem s where s.loadUnit.barcode = :barcode
select count(s) from StockItem s where s.loadUnit.barcode = :barcode and s.reservation.retrievalOrderLine.order.automatic = true
from Destination d where d.name = :name
select t.id from TransportOrder t where t.status = :status and t.target.name = :target order by t.id
hibernate-mapping.sql-query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transport_order WHERE load_unit_id = :loadUnitId
hibernate-mapping.query: from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit = :loadUnit and t.target = :target and t.status = :active
select t.target.name from TransportOrder t where t.loadUnit.barcode = :barcode and t.status = :active order by t.id desc
hibernate-mapping.sql-query: UPDATE stock_item SET reservation_id = NULL WHERE reservation_id IN (SELECT id FROM reservation WHERE stock_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM stock_item WHERE load_unit_id = :loadUnitId))
DELETE FROM reservation WHERE stock_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM stock_item WHERE load_unit_id = :loadUnitId)
UPDATE inventory_order_line SET load_unit_id = NULL WHERE load_unit_id = :loadUnitId
hibernate-mapping.query: select j.id from PrintJob j where j.status = :status and j.printer.type = :printerType
from PrintJob j where function('json_value', j.data, '$.orderId') = :orderId order by j.id desc fetch first 1 rows only
select count(t) from TransportOrder t where t.target.name = :target and t.status in :open
select count(distinct t) from TransportOrder t, StockItem s where s.loadUnit = t.loadUnit and t.target.name = :target and t.status in :open and s.reservation.retrievalOrderLine.order.id = :orderId
select count(s) from StockItem s where s.loadUnit.location.name = :location and s.loadUnit.barcode <> :ignore and s.reservation.retrievalOrderLine.order.id = :orderId
select count(u) from LoadUnit u where u.location.name = :name
select count(u) from LoadUnit u where u.location.name = :name and u.barcode <> :barcode
select t.id from TransportOrder t where t.status = :status and (t.target.name in :stations or (t.source.name = :decanting and t.loadUnit.type = :tote)) order by t.id
